name: David I. Grauer
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in White Plains, New York
side_practice_areas: Family Law, Business Litigation, General Litigation
about: Attorney David I. Grauer is the founder and owner of David I. Grauer, Attorney at Law, in White Plains, New York. A nationally ranked trial lawyer with more than 45 years of total legal experience, Mr. Grauer provides invaluable counsel, advocacy and support to a diverse range of clients across his region who have legal needs involving any of the following:

Focusing almost exclusively on civil litigation, Mr. Grauer has handled hundreds of trials and appeals, and he has achieved remarkable success helping his clients obtain the favorable outcomes they seek for the complex and pressing legal challenges efficiently and cost-effectively. A leader in his community, he served on the White Plains City Council for eight years and once served as president of the organization.

As an attorney, Mr. Grauer has gained a reputation for his aggressive and focused advocacy as well as his unwavering commitment to those he serves. Honored for his outstanding professionalism and service, he has earned consistent Martindale-Hubbell distinguished* peer review ratings along with many other top rankings and endorsements from his peers.

A 1976 graduate of Yeshiva University, Mr. Grauer attended Fordham University School of Law, where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 1977. The New York State Bar Association admitted him to practice that same year, and he is also admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York.

Mr. Grauer is an active member of the New York State Bar Association and the Westchester County Bar Association, among his other professional affiliations. He has also received "Superb" client ratings on Avvo for his stellar client service.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories - legal ability and general ethical standards.
